about_the_game:
Welcome to LumberJacked, a 3D incremental clicker game that takes place deep in a mysterious forest.

Chop trees, collect the logs, and toss them into the chipper to earn cash. Use your earnings to upgrade your strength and efficiency, or sharpen your axe allowing you to cut down increasingly tougher and more valuable trees.

Tunnel through trees to uncover the story, discover loot, and meet the locals who’ll trade tools for a price.

Destiny calls, do you embrace it, or defy it?

Features:

  • Be the Lumberjack: Chop down trees, and harvest them in the chipper to earn money.

  • Pump Some Iron: Upgrade your core stats to increase your efficiency

  • Hit the Grindstone: Sharpen your axe to improve its effectiveness against harder and more valuable trees

  • Treasures - Find various treasures and other discoverables to earn extra loot and tools.

  • Gnomes - Deal with gnomes who are ready to help you, for a fee.

  • Uncover the Mystery: Seek out the scattered story of the forest to discover your purpose in it.

  • Determine Your Destiny: Follow the clues and work with gnomes to uncover your story, and accept or deny your destiny through multiple endings.

  • Replayability: Play the game a second time to unlock purchasable skins & Golden Maple currency, uncover all secrets, and experience the second ending.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual Core
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: You wake up in a strange cabin deep in a mysterious forest, axe in hand, with only one way forward—through. Chop trees, sell logs, purchase and upgrade gear, and uncover the secrets hidden deep in the forest.
